newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees 1997 home appliance demand growing.
newsitem.headline: China sees 1997 home appliance demand growing.

text.p: China's market for household electrical appliances is expected to thrive in 1997, the Market Daily said on Friday.
Total demand for refrigerators was estimated at 6.7 million this year, up seven percent from the previous year, it quoted State Statistical Bureau figures as showing.
Total demand for washing machines would reach 16.1 million in 1997, up 15 percent compared with the year before, it said.
Demand for colour televisions was expected at 15.6 million, up 11 percent compared with 1996, it said.
Demand for air conditioners would top 5.7 million, up 12 percent from the year before, it said.
Output of the major household electrical appliances grew in the first quarter of this year, the newspaper said.

China's production of refrigerators rose 27.9 percent, washing machines climbed 20.6 percent, colour television rose 21 percent and air conditioners jumped 19.8 percent from a year ago, the newspaper said without giving comparative figures.
Exports of televisons in the first quarter reached 1.01 million, it said without giving further details.
